items.title: John "Picky" Brunious Interview, 1959-05-26
items.q: Sidney Desmond was playing trumpet and myself. Yeah. And Nelson was playing trombone.

ctx.x: How big a band was the rest of them?

Full band, yeah. Fourteen pieces or so? Well, yeah, three, three trumpets. Uh, let's see if I can remember some of the guys in there. Gaudet was playing trumpet. I don't know if you know Gaudet. Well, uh, he died just this last year. He was in California. Yeah. Well, he was, uh, he was one of the trumpet players. Mm-hmm. Sidney Desmond was playing trumpet and myself. Yeah. And Nelson was playing trombone. Oh, yeah. It's Louis Nelson. Oh, yeah. And the saxophone, let's see, they had, uh, Alton Poinel. Not Alton,…
He had a full rhythm section, a bass, and a fucking bar, and all.
